target.title: feat(radar): detect open PRs with overlapping diffs (report-only interference radar)
target.body:
## Summary

Adds a deterministic, report-only PR interference radar lane. It scans a target repository's open pull requests, parses each changed file's unified diff hunk headers into pre-image (base-branch) line intervals, and reports every pair of open pull requests whose diffs touch the same base files or overlapping base line ranges. GitHub only reports PR-vs-base conflicts at merge time; nothing today tells maintainers that merging one open PR will invalidate another open PR's review and proof. This lane surfaces exactly that, before either side merges.

Zero model calls, zero new dependencies, additive only, default-off.

## What changed

- `src/pr-interference.ts`: new pure module. Hunk header parsing into merged base intervals, two-stage pair detection (shared base path, then two-pointer interval intersection), severity (`lines` over `file`), a neutral `containment` fact (`a_within_b`, `b_within_a`, `equal`, `none`) for likely supersession, deterministic report building with a `sha256` digest over the stable JSON of the report core, and a markdown renderer.
- `src/pr-radar.ts`: thin entry (`dist/pr-radar.js`, `pnpm run pr-radar`). Read-only GETs via the `gh` CLI (`pulls?state=open` plus paged `pulls/N/files`), bounded by `--max-prs` (200), `--max-file-pages` (3), `--max-pairs` (50), writing `report.json` and `report.md` to a gitignored out dir. Truncation is always recorded in the report so a capped run is never mistaken for a complete scan.
- `dashboard/worker.ts`: a `PR Interference Radar` panel mirroring the sweep-status surface: reads `results/pr-radar/<slug>.json` from the state repository per target repo, adds `recent.pr_interference` to `/api/status`, and renders pairs with severity, containment, file paths, overlapping base lines, and scan freshness. Missing report renders an explicit empty state.
- `schema/clawsweeper-pr-interference.schema.json`: draft 2020-12 schema for the report artifact; tests assert the emitted report keys match the schema `required` lists.
- `.github/workflows/pr-radar.yml`: `workflow_dispatch` plus a schedule gated on `vars.CLAWSWEEPER_PR_RADAR_SCHEDULED == '1'`. Scan runs with `permissions: contents: read` and `GH_TOKEN: github.token` only. The optional publish step (dashboard feed) reuses the existing `create-state-token`/`setup-state`/`repair:publish-main` path and only runs when explicitly requested via the `publish` input or `vars.CLAWSWEEPER_PR_RADAR_PUBLISH == '1'`.
- `test/pr-interference.test.ts` (16 tests) and `test/pr-radar.test.ts` (5 tests): hunk edge cases (omitted counts, zero-count insertions and deletions, renames, removed files, missing patch), boundary and adjacency semantics, base-ref grouping, containment including the files-truncated guard, sort and cap behavior, digest determinism, schema shape, markdown rendering, and end-to-end entry runs through the `withMockGh` seam including failure paths.

## Design notes

- Coordinates: both diffs are relative to each PR's merge base with the shared base branch, so pre-image intervals live in base-branch coordinates and are directly comparable. Pull requests are only paired within the same `base.ref`. Merge-base drift between two PRs is accepted; this is an advisory signal, and the merge that causes drift already invalidates both reviews.
- Insertion hunks (`b == 0`) anchor to both neighboring base lines, matching git merge-conflict semantics for dual insertions at the same point.
- Added files and files whose patch GitHub omits (binary or oversized) degrade to whole-file granularity instead of being dropped.
- Containment is deliberately a fact, not advice: the lane never proposes merge order, labels, closes, or comments. Proposal-before-mutation is preserved; the only outputs are a JSON artifact, a markdown summary, and the dashboard panel.
- Containment is withheld (`none`) whenever either side's file list was truncated by the page cap, so a partial scan can never claim full containment.

## Real behavior proof

Real before and after behavior captured against live GitHub and the real dashboard worker; commands, output, and screenshots below (base `c089d676c1`, head `36b42dc01d`).

### Before (main, c089d676c190a86f8002fb63fe0c017a6ac4a7f6)

No interference surface exists anywhere:

```
$ grep -ric "pr-radar\|pr_radar\|interference" src dashboard .github/workflows package.json | grep -v ":0"
(no output, exit 1)
```

Dashboard rendered from main by the real worker (`pnpm run dashboard:dev`, wrangler dev at 127.0.0.1:8787): no radar panel exists.

![Dashboard before, main c089d676](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yetval/clawsweeper/radar-proof-assets/dashboard-before-c089d676.png)

### After (this branch, 36b42dc01daddb7c2a2392f4ff7fa036a63bff01)

Real read-only scan of live `openclaw/openclaw` with the built runtime:

```
$ pnpm run build:all
$ node dist/pr-radar.js scan --target-repo openclaw/openclaw --max-prs 150 --max-pairs 25 \
    --out-dir artifacts/pr-radar/openclaw-openclaw
```

Result: 150 open pull requests scanned, 25 real interfering pairs found, including pairs like #59898 and #63456 overlapping in `src/agents/system-prompt.ts`, and #18778 and #65205 overlapping across 13 gateway files. Full output: [report.md](https://github.com/yetval/clawsweeper/blob/radar-proof-assets/report.md), [report.json](https://github.com/yetval/clawsweeper/blob/radar-proof-assets/report.json).

Hand verification of one reported pair, `#40392` (head `254301db0102`) and `#61522` (head `99b57dd2c06b`), both editing `src/config/backup-rotation.ts`. Hunk headers straight from the `pulls/N/files` API:

```
PR 40392: @@ -2,6 @@  @@ -11,32 @@  @@ -53,21 @@  @@ -80,28 @@  @@ -110,13 @@
          -> base intervals [2,7] [11,42] [53,73] [80,107] [110,122]
PR 61522: @@ -1,5 @@  @@ -22,16 @@  @@ -89,8 @@  @@ -101,9 @@
          -> base intervals [1,5] [22,37] [89,96] [101,109]
Intersections: [2,5] [22,37] [89,96] [101,107]  (35 lines)
```

The radar reported exactly `[[2,5],[22,37],[89,96],[101,107]]` with `overlapping_line_total: 35` for this pair.

Dashboard rendered from this branch by the real worker, reading the scan output through the state-repository contents path the panel uses in production (`CLAWSWEEPER_STATE_REPO` override pointing at a fixture branch carrying the real report):

![Dashboard after, radar panel populated](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yetval/clawsweeper/radar-proof-assets/dashboard-after-radar.png)

Panel close-up showing both severities (lines and file), draft marking, per-pair overlapping line totals, and per-repo empty states. The eight pairs shown are a curated sample ([panel-fixture.json](https://github.com/yetval/clawsweeper/blob/radar-proof-assets/panel-fixture.json)) drawn from the 465 real pairs an uncapped rescan of the same 150 open pull requests produced (108 lines, 357 file, no containment pair exists in this window):

![Radar panel close-up](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yetval/clawsweeper/radar-proof-assets/dashboard-after-radar-panel.png)

`scripts/dashboard-smoke.mjs` passes against the branch worker with the panel present.

### Gates

`pnpm run check` green on Node 24: active-surface, limits, build:all, oxlint, test:unit, test:repair, coverage (all files 77.10 lines / 71.53 branches / 84.34 functions against 49/66/57 thresholds), oxfmt format check.

## Limits and non-goals

- Advisory only: no labels, comments, closes, merges, or repair dispatch.
- Known accepted ceilings: an insertion at end of file flags a phantom next line (a true positive for dual appends), an add versus rename-onto-the-same-path pair is not detected, and GitHub-omitted patches degrade to file granularity.
- Deferred follow-ups if maintainers want them: a durable per-PR advisory comment, a re-scan trigger when an interfering head moves, and feeding review freshness.
